description: This file contains the PHP implementation of the 'Total' class in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class extends a system model and defines the method getTotal, which adds the total amount information to the order totals array, loaded with language-specific text and configuration parameters.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: Represents the 'Total' extension model responsible for calculating and appending the order total information.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Public method that appends total amount entries to the list of totals, utilizing language strings and configuration for display and sort order.
